name: @ust-protocol/operator
description: The STATEFUL UST operator layer — chains, key logs, checkpoints, anchor batches, and composition above the structural bounds. Builds on ust-protocol (the stateless base) and produces exactly what it verifies. NOTE: the bare name `ustate` on npm belongs to a third party and must never be taken.

ust:browser.why: The stateful operator layer: streams, key-log, anchor batching. It runs where the publisher's keys and store are, which is a server. A browser is on the consuming side of everything this package produces.
